arms.A: key's sealed edition 7 setting (VBM / LSM4 / VBMslow of run_v5.ALL_SETTINGS) with probe_d6_settings {witness true, retract_position_target false} (= U8-A / D8-*-A)
arms.H3: A + H-3: T_r 0.5 s, N_s 4 (ASSUMPTION, spec 3.7)
arms.H1: A + H-1: W_d 0.6 s, same condition on B3 pre-twist start (ASSUMPTION, spec 3.7)
arms.H3n3: check only: H-3 code path with N_s 3 (identity with A)
arms.H1off: check only: H-1 code path with W_d -1 s (identity with A)

p89_metrics.csv.group: U (five RE1bF o0.0 keys), U_FS24, phase (3 G1 lines), regression (11)
p89_metrics.csv.final_phase: controller phase at the end of the run
p89_metrics.csv.t_event_s: event time of the r67 event branch [s]; empty for S7
p89_metrics.csv.gates_failed: event_output.gates keys whose value is false (r67 judge_event)
p89_metrics.csv.t_ready_back_s: event_output.t_ready_back_s [s after event]; empty = READY not reached after the event
p89_metrics.csv.ready_reached: event rows: t_ready_back_s finite; S7: t_first_ready_s present
p89_metrics.csv.reapproach_starts_rel: (t - t_event [s], leg) of every _begin_reapproach at or after the event (record wrapper)
p89_metrics.csv.reapproach_ends_rel: (t - t_event [s], leg, outcome) of every _end_reapproach at or after the event
p89_metrics.csv.j7_items: WARN/FAULT event names without numeric segments (judge_stage1_4368.event_name_436), WARN_ROD_PRESSURE_FALLBACK as (name:leg reason r) as jp3_ed7_rules.j7_items_ed7; set difference against A gives the new J7 items
p89_metrics.csv.events_capped: event list of the record has >= 200 entries (J7 not judgeable)
p89_metrics.csv.min_F_after_event_kN: min over legs of event_output.min_F_after_event_kN [kN] (1 ms true cylinder force after the event; negative = rod side tension floor of a lifted leg)
p89_metrics.csv.lifts: event_output.lifts per leg (sum_s, n, first_s, last_touch_s, max_gap_mm)
p89_metrics.csv.n_h3_extend / h3_extend_rel: H-3 periods where the exit count reached exit_samples (3) but the run needed N_s (4) (t - t_event, leg) = the normal rule would have ended there
p89_metrics.csv.n_h1_defer / h1_defer_rel: H-1 periods where _defers_reapproach returned true because of the H-1 wait (logged every deferred period)

selection_rule: spec P8-9 as written: (1) the five U RE1bF keys pass every U832* gate, (2) FS24 key event_output.pass, (3) on phase + regression keys 0 new failed gates, 0 new J7 items, 0 READY lost vs A; both eligible -> fewer keys with commands_sha256 != A, tie H-3; neither -> ask
